# Public documentation and review aids

Follow [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and the
[coverage index](../../engineering/README.md). Preserve inherited usage content;
add discoverability rather than rewriting legacy examples without approval.

Ground action facts in this repository's manifest and exact source revision.
Separate observed behavior, proposed policy and unknown runtime/consumer facts.
Do not duplicate endpoint strings, private repository excerpts, credentials,
customer data, token/response bodies or internal deployment details into docs.

Check complete new files, relative links/anchors, `applyTo` frontmatter and
matching repository paths offline. Declare runtime/render/build/test checks
UNRUN when not executed. Instructions/templates do not activate enforcement.
External process/core baseline links must be labeled proposed/UNPUBLISHED.
